title: Travel — mixed dims (strong LR, weaker GRA)
notes: Directionally uneven profile: LR/FC ahead of GRA; tests per-dimension Δ.

turns.text: Do you prefer travelling alone or with others?
I prefer travelling alone when I want flexibility. I can linger in a museum or change plans without negotiating every stop.
Last year I go to a mountain town. The sunrise above the clouds was breathtaking, and the local tea houses felt welcoming.
Is tourism always positive for local communities?
Not always. It brings income, but overcrowding can erode daily life. Cities need visitor caps or timed tickets so residents are not pushed aside.
